setup: In the Agents window, turn on welcome phrases and set a welcome name, in your application settings.
b1: First, put the name placeholder in three phrases in replace mode. Each new session shows the next phrase, with the name filled in.
b2: Second, switch to append mode, then reload a few times. Each reload shows the next phrase: two built-in ones, then your two.
b3: Last, set replace mode with an empty list. The welcome message disappears, and stays gone after a reload. The input still works.
cleanup: When you're done, remove these settings, or restore your own.
